build_langfuse_otel_logger: build a LangfuseOtelLogger instance that sends LLM spans to Langfuse via OpenTelemetry OTLP HTTP
create_langfuse_otel_attributes: create span attributes for Langfuse observability by calling set_langfuse_otel_attributes on an OTEL span
get_langfuse_otel_config: get an OpenTelemetryConfig for Langfuse by reading LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY from environment variables
construct_dynamic_otel_headers: construct dynamic Langfuse authorization headers from callback dynamic params for team or key based logging
set_langfuse_otel_attributes: set Langfuse specific metadata attributes on an OpenTelemetry span including input, output, and generation fields
